acceptance: The cause is recorded (memory limit or plan), with evidence.
TPC-DS SF0.01 power on SingleStore completes in release UAT, or 24a is pruned with a documented reason.
description:
From the load-value-integrity batch (#4043). TPC-DS now loads on SingleStore, but the power phase at SF0.01 fails at query 24a with an out-of-memory error on the 4 GiB local stack. joinorder SF1 was pruned with a documented reason: memsqld is OOM-killed on query 7c.

Change. Determine whether this is the stack's memory limit (compare against the release UAT runner's memory) or a query-plan problem on SingleStore. Then either size the UAT stack, or fix or prune the query with a recorded reason.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree; local stacks via make uat-bring-up under mocker, one at a time; no live cloud.
